jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer  | Robotics
jobs.description:
We build humanoid systems: full stack, from hardware and electronics to software and manufacturing, all in-house in Berlin.

At Cell Labs, we push the boundary of what robotics can achieve. Our goal is clear: to build systems that empower humans, not replace them. Our technology is already deployed with industry leading customers and partners. Now, our own product is close to launch.

The quiet phase is over. We are looking for people who want to be here early, take ownership, and help us build what others only talk about.

Location: Berlin (on-site) Start: Asap Employment Type: Full-time

Tasks

  • Mechanical Design & CAD: Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for humanoid systems, from actuators and kinematic mechanisms to sensor mounts and protective enclosures and model them in CAD (e.g. Onshape).
  • Actuator Kinematics: Design and optimize the kinematic structure of the robot's joints and limbs, including joint layouts, degrees of freedom, ranges of motion, and transmission mechanisms. Select and integrate actuators (motors, gearboxes, encoders) so that torque, speed, and load requirements are met across the full motion range.
  • Production Readiness: Optimize designs for series production with product requirements, user experience, and target cost in mind. Prepare the handover to manufacturing, including assembly processes, jigs and fixtures, and supplier ramp-up.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Prototype and validate mechanical systems for performance, safety, and durability. Design and build test rigs for actuators and subassemblies, including endurance and load testing.
  • Electronics Integration & Wiring: Integrate PCBs, sensors, and batteries into mechanical assemblies, including cable routing and heat management. Build and solder cables and wiring harnesses for prototypes and test setups.
  • Analysis & Materials: Run stress analysis and weight optimization to improve performance and longevity. Research, test, and qualify new materials and processes, such as composites and additive manufacturing.
  • Documentation & Specifications: Maintain complete design documentation, including drawings, part specifications, BOMs, and wiring diagrams, with full traceability throughout development.

Requirements

  • Background: You studied mechanical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, electrical engineering, or something close to it.
  • Experience: At least 3 years working on robotic systems, mobile machinery, or similar electromechanical products. What you built matters more to us than where you built it.
  • Mechanical Design: You've designed complex mechanical systems and understand robot kinematics, actuators, and how mechanical and electrical parts come together in a working robot.
  • Manufacturing: You know CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, and additive manufacturing, and you design with mid- and high-volume production in mind. You've worked with suppliers and brought hardware into production.
  • Hands-on: You like building things yourself. You solder cables, put together wiring harnesses, build test rigs, and track down problems on the bench.
  • Tools: You work confidently in Onshape and Autodesk Fusion, including its electronics design tools.
  • Product lifecycle: Ideally, you've taken at least one hardware product all the way from concept to series production.
  • How you work: You get a first prototype built quickly and improve from there. You can keep several projects moving at once and know when a design is good enough to move forward.
  • Languages: Fluent English. German is a plus.

Benefits

  • Your work goes into a real robot: The joints, assemblies, and test rigs you design end up in humanoid robots we build ourselves. You take ownership of real subsystems and see them go from CAD to working hardware.
  • Everything under one roof: Office, workshop, and test rigs are in the same building in Kreuzberg. Your design goes from screen to prototype in days. The electrical and software engineers are a short walk away, not a ticket**.**
  • Room to grow: Paid learning time and a personal budget for courses, conferences, and the tools you need. You'll get space to try new materials, processes, and ideas, and you'll take on more responsibility as the company grows.
  • Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, health, food, or fitness. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

Send us your CV and a few projects you've worked on. Ideally, include a mechanical system you designed and built yourself, with a short note on the challenges and how you solved them. No cover letter needed.

Process: Intro call → Technical deep-dive → On-site visit → Offer

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in engineering and tech. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

You'll join the Portfolio Games Team (PGT) within Live: a small, tech-first and AI-first team that manages and grows a catalogue of 40+ live mobile games played by millions of users worldwide, with many more titles being onboarded. We own the full lifecycle, from game health monitoring and A/B testing to ASO, release management and live operations.

To do this at portfolio scale we are building Sophia, our in-house AI agent that already manages games, runs A/B tests and automates store work across dozens of games. Our goal is simple: take humans out of the repetitive loop so the team can focus on making the product better.


Role

We are looking for a freelance Technical Artist to bridge art and engineering in an AI-first studio. Our development side already moves fast with Sophia; art production is now the bottleneck. Your mission is to set up the conventions, tools and pipelines that let AI generate, check and integrate 2D and 3D assets across our portfolio with minimal human intervention. By Q1 2027 we want Sophia running full art and 3D flows end to end, and you will be key to getting there.

You will work day to day with our dev lead and the engineer who owns our AI/Figma/Unity art workflows, and with the art team.

  • Define art conventions and standards (naming, structure, layout rules for UI, banners and store assets) so that assets can be produced and validated automatically, not hand-polished one by one

  • Build tools and scripts in art software (Maya, plus Photoshop/Illustrator where useful) that check and fix assets automatically, e.g. validating that 3D meshes are watertight, within poly budgets and correctly set up, so an AI agent can run them as part of a pipeline

  • Optimise 3D models and meshes (topology, polygon count, UVs, LODs) and textures (compression, sizes, atlases) for mobile, without sacrificing visual quality

  • Own the Unity import pipeline: import settings, asset post-processors and automation so assets land in our games correctly and consistently

  • Integrate AI generation tools (image, 3D, animation) into production workflows and evaluate new ones as they appear

  • Help scale animated assets (e.g. animated store banners and promo visuals) across many games through templates and automation rather than manual work

  • Debug and fix graphical and performance issues across mobile devices; support shaders, VFX and particles where needed

  • Document everything so the pipelines keep running and improving after setup

Profile

  • 5+ years as a Technical Artist, ideally in mobile games

  • Hands-on experience using AI in art production (e.g. Scenario, Flux, 3D generation tools, ComfyUI or similar), and a mindset of automating rather than perfecting by hand

  • Strong understanding of 3D models and meshes and how to optimise them; you don't need to be a 3D modeller, but you know what makes a mesh production-ready

  • Strong Unity skills: asset import and optimisation, C# scripting for editor tools; Shader Graph/HLSL, VFX and particles are a plus

  • Experience building tooling for art software, in particular Maya (Python and/or MEL)

  • Solid grounding in Photoshop and Illustrator: the "art" in technical art matters to us

  • Good understanding of mobile constraints (performance, memory, draw calls, batching)

  • Autonomous, pragmatic and deadline-driven: you know when an asset is good enough and move on

  • Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to have

  • Python scripting outside art tools (pipelines, batch processing, APIs)

  • Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and LLM-based agents

  • Figma, and experience with UI/store assets for mobile games (ASO)

  • Substance or similar texturing tools; GPU profiling

About the Customer Marketing team

Customer Marketing is Alan’s voice to customers, and their voice back to Alan.

Customer Marketing sits close to the business so we can hear the reality of customer and commercial conversations first-hand, craft the sharpest possible narrative, and turn what works into scalable programmes and assets.

As a Customer Marketer, you will turn customer, market, and field insight into clear narratives, useful programmes, and concrete actions that improve customer adoption, commercial effectiveness, and business growth.

Concretely, our team works on missions such as:

  • Turning customer and market insight into positioning, messaging, and narratives.

  • Helping commercial teams communicate and adopt our value proposition.

  • Designing customer or segment go-to-market programmes.

  • Supporting rollout, adoption, and feedback loops across teams or markets.

  • Bringing field signals back into Marketing, Product, and business decisions.

  • Turning customer discovery and market monitoring into actionable recommendations.

  • Scaling useful assets, programmes, and ways of working across markets and segments.

What you will do

  • Independently own an ambiguous but defined Customer Marketing workstream from diagnosis through rollout.

  • Turn customer, market, and field insight into clear narratives, useful programmes, and concrete actions.

  • Work with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and local teams to move initiatives forward.

  • Prioritise opportunities based on customer needs, business impact, and available evidence.

  • Design rollout, adoption, and feedback mechanisms.

  • Define relevant metrics, measure impact, and iterate based on results.

  • Connect Customer Marketing work to adoption, commercial effectiveness, or business growth.

What we are looking for

  • Experience owning a meaningful Customer Marketing, commercial, GTM, or customer-facing Marketing scope.

  • Strong customer and commercial judgment.

  • Ability to structure ambiguous problems and make clear choices.

  • Strong communication, narrative, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience turning insight into action, adoption, or measurable business impact.

  • Ability to work hands-on with limited direction.

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to expand your scope over time.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C1 level range.

jobs.title: TikTok Content Creator & Video Editor (m/w/d), Werkstudentenstelle
jobs.description:
Werkstudentenstelle · 15–20 h/Woche · 100 % remote

Über FLOWZOOM

Wir sind FLOWZOOM – eine Marke für hochwertige, innovative Reiseprodukte. Unser Fokus liegt auf Reisekissen, die Komfort, Funktionalität und ansprechendes Design verbinden. Seit 2018 sind wir auf Amazon zu Hause, jetzt bauen wir TikTok Shop Deutschland von Grund auf neu auf. Ihr besonderes Design macht unsere Reisekissen ideal für Short-Form-Videos mit Wow-Effekt: In wenigen Sekunden sieht man, was sie können.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Der kreative Part gehört dir. Du machst aus unserem Rohmaterial Creatives, die hängen bleiben, drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos und sorgst dafür, dass unser Brand Account Woche für Woche konstant postet. Das Ziel ist einfach: unseren Brand-Kanal mit starken, auf TikTok Shop optimierten Videos füllen. Zuschauer sollen kaufen und Creator sehen, welche Angles funktionieren und sich davon inspirieren lassen. Du entscheidest, wie FLOWZOOM auf TikTok aussieht und klingt und arbeitest eng mit unserem TikTok Shop Lead zusammen, der Kanalstrategie und Produktkatalog verantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben

Creatives-Erstellung:

  • Du schneidest Short-Form-Videos aus unserem bestehenden Rohmaterial, aus Material vom Team und aus deinem eigenen Footage (neue Hooks, neue Cuts, TikTok-Style)
  • Du drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos für unseren TikTok Shop Brand Account
  • Du veröffentlichst auf unserem Brand Account, hältst einen konstanten Posting-Rhythmus und gehst in den Austausch mit der Community
  • Du bereitest die besten Videos gemeinsam mit dem Social-Media-Team für Instagram und Facebook auf

Content-Analyse:

  • Du prüfst wöchentlich wie die Videos performt haben und verstehst warum (Hook, Format, CTA und Länge dokumentieren)
  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert – damit wir Creator-Briefings schärfen, unsere eigenen Videos verbessern und die stärksten Videos mit Ads boosten können
  • Du hältst unsere Video-Bibliothek in Ordnung und dokumentierst systematisch Nutzungsrechte

Unterstützung im Creator Management:

  • Du unterstützt bei Outreach, Onboarding und Aktivierung unserer TikTok-Shop-Affiliate-Creator – zum Beispiel, indem du Briefings verbesserst oder inaktiven Creatorn Beispielvideos schickst

Der Content, den wir im Kopf haben

  • Ein Startpunkt, den du mitgestaltest:
  • Du testest einen Mix aus Formaten: Videos mit dir vor der Kamera, faceless Content (POV, Voiceover, Produkt in Action) sowie Clips von Team und Creatorn
  • Du filterst wiederkehrende Formate heraus: ein paar Serien, die unsere Zuschauer wiedererkennen und für die sie zurückkommen, z. B. „A vs. B"
  • Authentische Travel- und Lifestyle-Momente: das Kissen im echten Leben (Flughafen, Flugzeug, Zug, Roadtrip) – kein reiner Verkaufs-Content
  • Unser Ton: lustig, schnell und abenteuerlustig, aber ehrlich. Wir zeigen, was das Produkt wirklich kann.

Woran wir nach drei Monaten sehen, dass es läuft

  • Unser Account postet konstant 4–5 Videos pro Woche, in einem Format-Mix, der nach FLOWZOOM klingt
  • Wir haben 2–3 wiederkehrende Formate gefunden, die am besten funktionieren
  • Wir kennen unsere Top 3–5 Hooks und Formate – und sie sind dokumentiert
  • Die Video-Bibliothek ist sortiert und bei jedem Clip sind die Nutzungsrechte klar

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Short-Form-Editing – idealerweise ein Portfolio an TikToks, Reels oder Shorts, das du zeigen kannst
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Schnitt-Tools (z. B. CapCut, Premiere oder Final Cut)
  • Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl
  • Du kannst die Performance eines Videos anhand von KPIs analysieren (z. B. Engagement, Retention …)
  • Du hast ein Gespür für TikTok, für Trends und für das, was Leute gern schauen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und du sprichst fließend Englisch (unsere Teamsprache)
  • Du bist immatrikuliert

Nice-to-have:

  • Du nutzt gern AI-Tools, die dir das Leben leichter machen – etwa um bei Ideen, Analyse oder Recherche Zeit zu sparen
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Affiliate- oder Creator-Marketing

Nicht erforderlich:

  • TikTok-Shop-Erfahrung. Ein Hintergrund in Content, Social Media oder E-Commerce zählt genauso.

Konditionen

  • 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, remote, flexible Zeiteinteilung
  • Werkstudium: Wir starten bei 16–18 EUR brutto pro Stunde, das sind rund 1.400–1.550 EUR brutto im Monat bei 20 Stunden/Woche. Wenn es gut läuft, ist Luft nach oben!

Benefits

Wie wir ticken

  • Wir bauen auf der Meinung unserer Kunden auf: Customer Insights und das, was ihr Feedback uns zeigt, sind der Motor für alles, was wir erstellen
  • Wir leben Ownership, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Transparenz
  • Wir arbeiten als Team zusammen – und trotzdem jeder eigenständig und fokussiert
  • Und das Beste: Wir arbeiten 100 % remote und sind flexibel bei den Arbeitszeiten

Was dich erwartet

  • Ownership über unseren Brand-Kanal und unserer Affiliate-Engine: Wir bauen von Grund auf neu und du prägst, wie das aussieht
  • Direktes Feedback: Jede Woche siehst du, was deine Videos erreichen und was deine Arbeit bewirkt
  • Ein internationales, entspanntes Team ohne komplizierte Hierarchien
  • Raus aus der Theorie, rein in die Praxis: Hands-on Erfahrung in der Welt der Creative Economy

jobs.title: Chief Business Officer (gn) @ Clean Data Centres Venture, France (hybrid)
jobs.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

Why we exist

Every frontier model is now gated by two things: megawatts and cooling. Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political.

Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach.

So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, we bring the load to the power. Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation.

  • 70%+ capacity factor — offshore wind that behaves like baseload

  • ~€50/MWh target cost for firm, low-carbon power

  • Zero grid queue. Zero freshwater. Zero land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack.

Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027.

The role

This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own Offshore Compute, our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work.

You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer.

What you'll do

  • Write the go-to-market from a blank page. Build the global commercial roadmap, from first demonstrator workloads to full fleet monetisation.

  • Land the anchor deals. Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators.

  • Turn variable power into a feature. Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds.

  • Connect the C-suite to the hull. Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers.

  • Create a category. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class.

  • Be the face of it. Represent us at the top AI, cloud and infrastructure summits worldwide and make us the reference for next-generation AI energy infrastructure.

You might be the one if

  • You've been in the room where AI capacity gets bought. You've sold, built or run serious infrastructure in the neocloud, AI infra, CSP or hyperscale data center world, and you've closed the kind of deals that move megawatts. We care about what you've shipped, not what your business card said.

  • You know GPU economics inside out. H100 / B200 / GB200 cluster economics, orchestration, workload constraints. And you know the people across the neocloud and AI ecosystem who sign capacity deals.

  • You speak the physics. MW-scale power delivery, PUE, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, thermal budgets. You can explain in one slide why land-based data centers are hitting the grid wall.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
jobs.description:
Hey, I'm Adrian. I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.

What you'll actually own

1. Make creator search meaningfully better.

You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them.

2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence.

You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience.

3. Ship new search capabilities into production.

You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters.

4. Own the system end to end.

You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks.

What the day-to-day looks like

Here’s what a typical week might include:

  • Monday. A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement.
  • Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost.
  • Wednesday. You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators.
  • Thursday. You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production.
  • Friday. You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence.

We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch.

Requirements

What you've done before

  • Built large-scale data or backend products. You have solid experience working with systems where volume, latency, reliability, and cost all matter.
  • Shipped products from concept to production. You’ve owned scoping, architecture, implementation, release, measurement, and iteration—not just one layer of the solution.
  • Designed distributed systems. You can reason clearly about throughput, failure modes, data flow, scalability, and operational tradeoffs.
  • Built LLM-powered or agentic features in production. You understand the practical differences between models and can balance capability against latency and cost.
  • Worked autonomously on ambiguous problems. You know how to gather requirements, ask useful questions, and turn incomplete context into forward motion.
  • Communicated clearly across teams. You can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers, give direct feedback, and collaborate without creating unnecessary process.
  • Worked in a fast-moving product environment. You’re comfortable learning quickly, shipping incrementally, and changing direction when the evidence does.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with multimodal embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, ranking algorithms, model deployment, self-hosted models, or GPU infrastructure. Curiosity about the creator economy helps too, but we’ll get you up to speed.

Our stack

  • AWS and GCP, with Pulumi for infrastructure as code
  • Python, TypeScript, and Node.js
  • PySpark on AWS EMR
  • Airflow
  • Milvus Vector DB through Zilliz
  • Elasticsearch
  • LLM batch APIs
  • Apache Iceberg
  • SageMaker, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS, and Aurora
  • Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Cursor

The interview process

We move quickly and can complete the process in under a week:

  1. Intro chat
  2. Coding interview
  3. System design interview
  4. Team interview
  5. Culture and alignment conversation with our CEO, Avery Schrader

Benefits

What we offer

  • Fully remote in Europe 🏠 Work from wherever you do your best work, with some overlap with GMT+3.
  • Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 100,000€ - 130,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible hours ⏱ We care about outcomes, not when you log on.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you’re rested and happy, you do better work. Take what you need.
  • Personal development support 🧠 Courses, books, and conferences are on us when they help you grow.
  • Real ownership 💡 Take difficult search problems from idea to production without layers of unnecessary process.
  • Regular offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

And a little more about us...

Founded in 2018 by a high-school dropout and a Canadian (yes, we’re also shocked it’s going so well), Modash is building a suite of tools that help brands scale partnerships with online content creators.

2,700+ companies like Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN already use Modash to manage and scale their influencer marketing work. And we're just getting started. Over the coming decade, brand investment in creators will continue to boom, and Modash will be at the centre of it all.

Modash is here to stay. We have 8-figures in ARR across two products, a $12M series A investment, and we are default alive. We are building a company that will still be here in 20 years; not rushing towards an exit.

We’re almost 100 people distributed across 20+ countries, operating with a fast, async-first culture. If you join Modash, you’ll be surrounded by people who truly want to be the greatest at their craft. People who make you better. Interesting people too, who have done everything from building solar cars, to hanging out with Metallica and Bon Jovi.

Come join us. Be great, do great things, create great memories, all while making a great impact. Do it.

If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the creators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs in London, Madrid, and Shenzhen. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
Ultralytics is hiring its first in-house lawyer. There's no legal team to join — you're building it. That means setting up how contracts get reviewed, collaborating with outside counsel across jurisdictions, and deciding what processes are actually worth having at a company this size, rather than inheriting someone else's playbook.

The first priority is the part of the business that generates revenue directly: the AGPL-3.0 and Enterprise dual-licensing model behind YOLO. Every company using Ultralytics' models commercially either open-sources their entire project under AGPL-3.0 or buys an Enterprise license. Supporting compliance, converting violations into contracts, and negotiating Enterprise agreements are core to the P&L, not a background compliance task. We need someone who's done this kind of work before, not someone learning open-source licensing on the job.

🚀 What you'll do

Open-source licensing and IP

  • Own the AGPL-3.0 and Enterprise licensing model end to end: detect likely violations, lead outreach and negotiation to convert unlicensed commercial use into paid Enterprise agreements.

  • Structure and negotiate enterprise license agreements directly with customers — scope, pricing triggers, audit rights, term.

  • Own IP portfolio strategy and lifecycle (trademarks, copyright, trade secrets), working with external IP agents and attorneys for filings and renewals rather than filing directly.

  • Set and maintain the open-source contribution and dependency policy — what can come in, what obligations it carries, how attribution and notices are handled.


Commercial contracts

  • Draft, review, and negotiate SaaS, licensing, distribution, partnership, and vendor agreements.

  • Build contract templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and approval workflows from the ground up.

  • Own liability, indemnity, warranty, and risk positions across customer and vendor contracts.

  • Partner with Sales, Operations, Finance, Product, and Engineering to close deals and manage legal risk.


Privacy, compliance, and legal operations

  • Advise on GDPR, data processing agreements, and international data transfers across the UK, EU, US, and China.

  • Establish proportionate AI governance and regulatory compliance processes.

  • Select and manage outside counsel across the UK, Spain, China, and other jurisdictions as needed.

  • Introduce practical systems for matter management, contract tracking, legal intake, and reporting.

jobs.description:
Founding Product Designer (UX/UI & Research)

London (Hybrid) | Full-time | £70 - £85K + early-team equity


The role

We’re a well-funded startup building category-defining AI for architecture, engineering and construction: an archaic industry at a critical juncture. The Building Safety Act now requires firms to evidence their design decisions, and directors carry personal liability.

Join Bite as our first in-house designer working strategically and directly with the head of product, founders and engineering team, you’ll own the entire design function and lead the transformation of our beta into a high-quality user experience that shapes the future of Bite’s AI for the built environment.

Why join Bite

The problem is genuinely hard. When a structural engineer changes a component in their building design model, the same component exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don’t understand, and with no shared identifier. Detecting these changes, predicting the downstream impacts and propagating them using AI under the engineer's supervision is the core of our product.

You'll own the UX/UI for the whole product, not a slice of it. There's no design team to inherit and no feature factory to work around. You set the direction, the patterns and the quality bar, and you'll prototype, test and ship rapidly with a small team that can pivot, fast.

Your work ships to people who pay. The beta is in production with signed customers that include some of the UK's leading structural engineering firms who are keen to build with us. With our tight feedback loops, you’ll have plenty of data to help drive your design decisions.

What we're building

Structural engineers work across numerous, fragmented sets of tools with no shared source of truth. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive.

Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering. The platform does three things that today take weeks of manual work: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection e.g. "I changed Column C7 in the structural model - what drawings, schedules, and specs are now out of date?" and propagation of those changes to every affected file.


What you’ll do

  • Set the design direction for our products and raise the overall bar for craft and quality.

  • Establish and scale our design foundations, including the design system and UI patterns.

  • Shape the visual identity and brand across every customer touchpoint.

  • Partner with customers to shape product vision, design strategy, and the experience roadmap.

  • Collaborate with the head of product, founders and engineering team to define problems, explore solution spaces, validate concepts, ensure technical feasibility and ship product improvements that move the metrics that matter.

  • Analyse product performance to identify friction points and drive iterative optimisation, aligning business goals with user-centred product opportunities.

  • Lead comprehensive user research, including interviews, surveys, behavioural analysis, prototype testing, and usability studies, to identify user needs, confirm concepts, and produce actionable insights.

  • Translate insights, data, and business needs into user journeys, wireframes, prototypes and ultimately end-to-end, intuitive design solutions that drive meaningful improvements.

  • Facilitate workshops to build shared understanding and present design decisions clearly to influence strategic, experience-led discussions.

  • Encode the judgment and complexity required for complex workflows under the hood, while keeping the user experience simple and seamless.

  • Stay current on emerging AI trends and product patterns. Build a clear point of view on what matters, and bring that perspective into how we design at Bite.

What we need from you

  • A senior or lead product designer with 5+ years of experience (preferably shipping high-quality B2B products, with expertise in AI products).

  • An autonomous, opinionated builder who is comfortable being the sole designer and enjoys facilitating design sprints and principles within an engineering team.

  • A creative excited to work in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • A proven IC track record of expertise across UX/UI research, including interviews, surveys, usability testing, behavioural analysis, and the ability to translate insights into end-to-end digital experiences at scale.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and fluency in data, using qualitative and quantitative signals to validate design decisions, measure impact, and inform tradeoffs.

  • Evidence of shipping work that moved real business or operational metrics, and an ability to talk about those numbers fluently.

  • Demonstrated understanding of human-centred design principles and usability best practices, responsive design, product, technical, and business constraints in real-world environments.

  • Demonstrable ability to build intuitive, user-centred experiences supported by a portfolio showing strong interaction design foundation, high-quality visual craft and attention to detail, structured problem framing and systems thinking.

  • Advanced experience working with AI-native research, design, and collaboration tools and advanced proficiency in Figma.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, concise, customer-ready documentation.

  • Ability to move fluidly between the big question (what should this experience do?) and the craft-level detail that makes high-stakes decisions feel simple.

  • Highly organised and adaptable, able to balance critical thinking with hands-on delivery, while contributing to the evolution of the design system and culture.

  • Experience working autonomously to design complex, multi-step product flows.

What you can expect from us

  • Flexible, hybrid working

  • Genuine ownership and an open and creative environment where you’ll help us define the future of Bite, what we work on and our culture

  • Passionate, growth-minded people with an entrepreneurial mindset and the confidence to operate autonomously within a fast-moving startup environment

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth (Marketing)
jobs.description:
TL;DR:
We're looking for a full-stack engineer who wants to sit at the heart of Lovable's marketing engine - making every pound of spend measurable, and every manual workflow a tool. One sprint you're tracing spend from first click to revenue across Meta, Google and newer channels; the next you're shipping landing pages, experiments or an agent that saves the team hours a week. You think in React and APIs, but your first instinct is always: can we measure it, and does it help us grow faster?

Coding skills + excellent taste + growth instincts + marketing obsession = you.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience building and growing user-facing products in high-performing teams, ideally including growth work, marketplaces/platforms, or communities.

  • Strong product sense and UX taste for multi-sided systems with creators, learners, and customers - you can see problems from multiple sides and design for all of them.

  • Knowledge of Meta Pixel and Google Ad Network APIs, and experience working with data from ad networks. Experience with TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit and Beehiiv, plus CTV/podcast tracking, is a plus.

  • Comfortable using data, funnels, analytics, attribution, and A/B testing to shape what you build and how you iterate.

  • Skilled at designing, measuring, and iterating experiments, and thorough in setting up growth systems "right" from the start.

  • Experience collaborating across functions (design, marketing, partnerships, support, data) to launch and grow new product surfaces and ecosystems.

  • Enjoys designing reusable growth, ecosystem, and monetization tools that other builders can plug into, with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset.

  • Motivated by helping others succeed and by seeing impact through engagement, measurable results, and revenue - you care about the scoreboard as much as the code.

What you’ll do

In one sentence: You'll sit between marketing and engineering and build whatever we need to grow faster, from the site and tracking to the tools the team uses every day - expect to be driving the thinking here alongside our team leads.

  • Build the tools marketing runs on: Find the manual work slowing the team down and replace it with tools, automations or agents, ideally built on Lovable.

  • Shape what gets built: Work with design, marketing, data and partnerships to decide what's worth doing, then own it end to end.

  • Own how we measure marketing: Make sure every pound of spend can be traced from first click to revenue, across Meta and Google and newer channels like CTV and podcast. This is what lets us scale spend with confidence.

  • Make experimentation cheap & fast: Build the events, funnels and A/B testing setup that let the team test an idea in days and double down on what works.

  • Turn the website into a growth surface: Ship landing pages, signup flows and first-run moments that get new users to value fast, without waiting in a product queue.

  • Keep it Lovable: Growth should feel like part of the product, never bolted on.

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Frontend: React

  • Backend: Golang and Rust

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers

  • DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

**ChillQuanta is developing an electro-optic spectrometer for inspecting and characterizing photonic qubits (semiconductor quantum-dot single- and entangled-photon sources), aiming to replace or combine today's separate methods (capacitance-voltage, photoluminescence, resonance fluorescence spectroscopy) with one new sub-100-femtosecond-resolution, non-destructive electro-optic technique — with a patent filing already in progress. Target market: quantum and semiconductor chip makers.

**The opportunity
**Founded by Amar Alok (CEO, PhD in Experimental Physics from RUB, 4+ years in ultrafast optics and pump-probe spectroscopy) alongside a Chemistry postdoc, ChillQuanta has a lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, an Invention Disclosure accepted by RUB (April 2026) with a manuscript in preparation for Physical Review Letters, and over €12k raised so far. The next step is turning the lab prototype into an automated instrument and deciding between licensing and starting a company — which is where a business co-founder comes in. ChillQuanta is separately also open to an AI/ML co-founder to help build wafer-scale AI prediction capability.

Tasks

What you will own

Company build-up & strategy
- Help decide and execute the path from lab prototype to company: licensing vs. start-up, incorporation, and go-to-market strategy for the quantum/semiconductor metrology market.
- Own fundraising strategy and investor relations as ChillQuanta moves beyond its initial ~€12k raised.

Commercialization
- Turn the lab prototype (TRL 3-4) into an automated, sellable instrument in partnership with the technical team.
- Build relationships with semiconductor and quantum chip makers as early customers and design partners.
Business operations
- Establish the commercial and operational foundation (pricing, business model, partnerships) the founding science team doesn't yet have.

Requirements

**What you bring
**

**Core experience
**- Business development or MBA-level commercial experience, ideally with deep-tech, scientific instrumentation, or semiconductor/quantum industry exposure.
- Comfort making a licensing-vs-startup call and building a go-to-market plan from a lab-stage prototype.

**Especially valuable
**- Existing network in quantum technology, semiconductor metrology, or scientific instrumentation.
- Fundraising experience for deep-tech ventures (grants and/or investors).
- ChillQuanta is separately seeking an AI/ML co-founder to build wafer-scale AI prediction — relevant ML/software experience is valuable for that parallel track.

Benefits

Why join ChillQuanta
- A validated lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, with an Invention Disclosure already accepted by RUB and a manuscript heading to Physical Review Letters.
- A genuinely novel technique (patent filing in progress) addressing a real gap in photonic-qubit inspection for the fast-growing quantum and semiconductor chip markets.
- Ground-floor business co-founder equity alongside a strong physics/chemistry founding team.

Retail Sales Manager / Vertriebsmitarbeiter (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

 

Wolt ist im August 2020 in Deutschland gestartet und hat zunächst Kund:innen in Berlin mit großartigen lokalen Restaurants verbunden. Seitdem haben wir uns zu einer führenden Plattform für lokalen Handel entwickelt – und bringen heute alles von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln über Blumen und Home-&-Living-Produkte bis hin zu Unterhaltungselektronik direkt an die Haustür unserer Kund:innen.

Jetzt ist ein besonders spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres Retail-Teams zu werden. Wolt wächst in Deutschland rasant und arbeitet mit einigen der bekanntesten Handelsmarken des Landes zusammen. Zuletzt haben wir unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn gestartet: Rund 2.000 Elektronikartikel – von Smartphones bis zu Spielkonsolen – können in großen deutschen Städten, darunter Berlin, innerhalb von etwa 35 Minuten geliefert werden.

Wir bauen unser Retail-Geschäft in Deutschland nun deutlich aus und suchen ambitionierte Sales-Talente, die gemeinsam mit uns die besten lokalen Handelspartner auf die Wolt-Plattform bringen. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den On-Demand-Handel in Berlin aktiv mit, gewinnst hochwertige Partner und hilfst dabei, neu zu definieren, wie Menschen lokal einkaufen.

Erfahre mehr über unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn und entdecke die neuesten Updates im Wolt Deutschland Newsroom.

Deine Hauptaufgaben bei Wolt

  • Identifikation & Akquise: Du bist verantwortlich für das Sourcing der besten Retail-Partner der Stadt. Dein Ziel ist es, Supermärkte und erstklassige Non-Food-Venues im Raum Berlin zu gewinnen und diese zu optimalen Konditionen auf die Wolt-Plattform zu bringen.
  • Pipeline-Management: Du steuerst deine Sales-Pipeline eigenständig und baust belastbare Netzwerke zu Inhaber:innen sowie Geschäftsleiter:innen im Einzelhandel auf.
  • Überzeugende Präsentation: Du positionierst Wolt als führende E-Commerce-Lösung. Dabei hörst du potenziellen Partnern aktiv zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und überzeugst Entscheidungsträger durch passgenaue Mehrwerte.
  • Präsenz vor Ort: Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Außendienst. Deine Woche besteht aus ca. 1–2 Tagen strategischer Planung und Cold Calling (Home Office) sowie 3–4 Tagen im Außendienst in Berlin (inkl. gelegentlicher Hotelübernachtungen).
  • Schnittstellenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team zusammen, um eine perfekte Abbildung deiner Partner – vom Supermarkt bis zum Blumenladen – auf unserer Plattform sicherzustellen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Vertriebsprofi im Außendienst: Du hast bereits 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Sales und liebst den Kaltkundenkontakt. Es motiviert dich, Partner proaktiv vor Ort zu besuchen und zu überzeugen.
  • Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit: Du kommunizierst souverän auf Augenhöhe – vom Blumenladen bis zum C-Level-Entscheider. Dabei bleibst du immer authentisch und zielorientiert.
  • Performance-Drive: Du willst der Beste sein und die Top-Retail-Partner der Stadt für Wolt gewinnen, um unseren Marktanteil signifikant auszubauen.
  • Selbstorganisation: Du planst deine Walk-in-Routen effizient, trackst deine Aktivitäten eigenständig und managest deine Pipeline absolut zuverlässig.
  • Positives Mindset: Du bist hartnäckig, denkst lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei Gegenwind deine positive Ausstrahlung.
  • Qualifikation & Sprache: Studium oder Ausbildung, fließendes Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Was wir dir anbieten:

  • Gestalte die Zukunft des Handels: Wir verändern, wie Menschen einkaufen. Dein Job ist es, den lokalen Handel so effizient zu machen, dass unsere Kunden Zeit für Wichtigeres gewinnen, anstatt sie in Warteschlangen im Supermarkt zu verbringen.
  • Wachstum & Impact: Nutze die steile Lernkurve eines globalen Tech-Unternehmens und entwickle unsere bereits etablierten Märkte in Berlin auf das nächste Level.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Arbeite selbständig in einem dynamischen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und direktem Einfluss auf den Markterfolg.
  • Mobilität & Equipment: Du erhältst Top-Hardware (iPhone & MacBook) und die Option auf einen Firmenwagen für deine Einsätze im Außendienst.
  • Wolt-Benefits: Rabatte auf Wolt-Bestellungen, ÖPNV-Zuschuss sowie Wellness-Angebote (z. B. Urban Sports Club).
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten. 

Nächste Schritte

Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist unkompliziert und transparent:

  1. Recruiter Screening: Ein erstes Gespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team, um dich, deine bisherige Erfahrung und deine Motivation für Wolt kennenzulernen.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: Ein vertiefendes Gespräch mit dem Hiring Manager, in dem wir mehr über deine Vertriebserfahrung, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Motivation für die Rolle erfahren möchten.
  3. Role Play: Eine praxisnahe Sales-Übung, bei der du uns deinen Ansatz bei der Kundenansprache, im Pitch und im Umgang mit Einwänden zeigen kannst.

Bereit, mit uns Geschichte zu schreiben?

Wir verändern nicht nur den Handel – wir geben den Menschen Zeit für das zurück, was sie wirklich lieben. Wenn du in einem High-Growth-Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen willst und ein Team suchst, das Ambition mit Spaß verbindet, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Bewirb dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam den Markt revolutionieren!

Wichtiger Hinweis: Um deine Daten bestmöglich zu schützen (GDPR), akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. Bitte nutze ausschließlich unsere Karriereseite für deine Bewerbung. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (all genders)
jobs.description:
JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Designer (all genders) to contribute to shaping the design vision and elevate our product design function. This is your chance to make a lasting impact on a platform used by millions — with a focus on content discovery, player motivation, and engagement design. You’ll bring proven expertise in gamification, with a demonstrated ability to create experiences that inspire players and drive retention.

You’ll drive business impact through design, ensuring every player interaction contributes to JustPlay’s growth and mission. You’ll also help unlock operational efficiency by integrating AI tools and workflows across the digital product development lifecycle, helping teams move faster and smarter.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to deliver both bold long-term ideas and immediate, high-impact improvements.

 

Job Requirements

  • 2-3 years of experience designing end-to-end mobile product experiences, ideally in gaming or entertainment

  • Experience scaling or refining established design teams and processes

  • A portfolio showcasing impactful mobile design work

  • Proven expertise in gamification and user engagement

  • Expert proficiency in Figma

  • Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to craft

  • You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

  • Background in loyalty or rewards platforms

  • Mobile gaming experience.

  • Deep understanding of mobile gaming trends and the advertising landscape

 

Job Responsibilities

Hands-On Design

  • Contribute to user experience from conception to launch, developing and advocating the design vision for one of the world's top entertainment apps

  • Create user-centric designs, wireframes, prototypes, and mockups for the JustPlay app

  • Develop features that elevate the entire player journey, with emphasis on game discovery and loyalty gamification

  • Drive measurable business outcomes through design decisions that balance player delight and company growth

  • Support evolving JustPlay's design guidelines and design system

Collaboration & Strategy

  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to develop innovative solutions within technical constraints

  • Apply platform best practices (iOS, Android) to ensure design quality and seamless interactions across devices

  • Transform research insights and analytics into actionable design concepts

  • Work with cross-functional leaders to identify where AI and automation can streamline design operations

Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain effective design processes that scale with your team

  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance product usability

  • Stay current with mobile gaming trends and the advertising ecosystem

  • Foster a high-performing, growth-minded design team through mentorship and feedback

  • Champion product design throughout the organization, educating stakeholders and establishing design-led practices

  • Contribute to building a culture of craft, collaboration, and continuous learning

Job benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

* Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

 

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

 

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing quality engineer to own the quality and reliability of the Gravis hardware package that turns regular excavators into awesome, autonomous machines. You will work with our engineering and production team in Zurich defining and implementing quality measures like incoming inspections, supply chain validations, failure analysis and product return teardowns to enable our custom AI hardware a safe and reliable operation of heavy machines. You are capable of working both independently and with others, and are intrinsically driven to solve challenging applied problems with a rigorous attention to detail and an exploratory imagination.

You are our first quality hire. There is no dedicated quality team, no lab, and no playbook; you will design the test / fixture / process and then go build it.

  • A confident, credible communicator and presenter in front of senior client stakeholders.

  • Specifically, you will be facilitating the evolution of our code base from C# to Rust and the ecosystem of tools, practices and services that implies, with AI central to how we handle requirements, testing and code generation.

Over our 20+ years in the market we have worked with a diverse range of commercial, non-profit, and government organisations.

    We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Our work starts from real stakeholder needs and the value they unlock, with an AI-assisted pipeline now generating much of the code.As a result, our digital platforms are a mixture of custom components and external services which produce a powerful and engaging experience when combined.

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Dans ce contexte, l’application permet aux utilisateurs d’uploader de nombreux types de fichiers (PDF, Word, images, etc) à partir de nombreuses sources.

L’objectif du stage est d’améliorer les outils présents dans l’application pour visualiser et manipuler ces documents. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Visualiser les PDF mais également d’autres types de documents (Word, images, etc) directement dans le navigateur, d’une manière scalable et sécurisée,
  • Ajouter plus d’options pour configurer la visualisation (zoom, recherche, orientation, etc),
  • Superposer le texte issu de l’OCR au document original afin de permettre à l’utilisateur de sélectionner et copier le texte,
  • Ajouter des fonctionnalités de découpage, fusion, et de changement d’ordre des pages,
  • Et d’autres fonctionnalités !

Ces fonctionnalités sont disponibles à travers toute l’expérience de Doctrine autour des documents privés, y compris dans l’Assistant, les dossiers collaboratifs, et les outils spécialisés tels Flow Litigate et Flow Counsel.

Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Productivity, et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).

Product Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About us

SFG20 is the industry standard for building maintenance. Providing services and pioneering technologies that empower people to create and sustain safer buildings.

Our mission is to make buildings better using our standard, software and expertise. Our vision is to become the leading authority for built environment maintenance that protects and enhances quality of life.

About the role

The Product Business Analyst bridges the gap between business needs and engineering delivery, turning ideas, requests and requirements into clear, actionable work.

By bringing clarity to ambiguity, connecting work across Product and Platform Engineering and making sure teams have the information they need, the role helps reduce rework, improve delivery and build better software for our customers.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery and shaping

  • Work with stakeholders to explore ideas, requests and feedback, clarifying the underlying problem, business need and intended outcome before work is defined

  • Explore the reasons behind requests before work is defined, ensuring relevant context and requirements are understood.

  • Challenge assumptions constructively, identify gaps and surface conflicting needs or unanswered questions early.

  • Identify and engage the right stakeholders to provide the information and decisions needed to shape clear requirements.

Turning needs into actionable work

  • Translate business needs into clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria that give engineering teams sufficient context to progress work effectively.

  • Break down defined or moderately complex initiatives into clear, deliverable increments, working with Product and Engineering colleagues and seeking support on more complex work where needed,

  • Maintain accurate requirements and supporting context in Jira, including agreed scope, relevant decisions and material changes.

  • Keep requirements current as understanding or scope develops, working with relevant Product, Engineering and project colleagues to capture what has changed and why.

Question resolution during delivery

  • Remain closely involved during delivery as a point of contact for requirements-related questions and clarification.

  • Investigate ambiguity, work with the right stakeholders to resolve requirements questions and escalate more complex issues where needed so engineering teams can continue with clear direction.

  • Participate in refinement and planning discussions where business analysis input is needed to clarify scope, requirements or agreed decisions.

  • Maintain traceability from the original business need through agreed requirements and material changes to what is ultimately delivered.

Integrating product and platform work

  • Maintain awareness of relevant work across Product and Platform Engineering and identify dependencies, overlaps or potential impacts between teams.

  • Help shape requirements where product and platform changes need to work together, ensuring relevant dependencies and constraints are understood.

  • Flag where teams may be addressing the same problem, where proposed changes could conflict, or where work in one area creates an impact elsewhere.

  • Support effective handovers and cross-team working by ensuring teams have the requirements context and documentation they need.

Stakeholder engagement

  • Build constructive working relationships across Product, Engineering, QA, customer-facing teams and the wider business.

  • Translate engineering questions and constraints into clear language for business stakeholders.

  • Translate business needs and agreed intent into precise, actionable requirements for engineering teams.

  • Help stakeholders understand what has been agreed from a requirements perspective, what remains unresolved and where further input or decisions are needed.

Essential experience

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst, or in a closely related analysis role, within software delivery.

  • Strong requirements elicitation and analysis skills, including the ability to work from incomplete or ambiguous information, identify gaps and challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Ability to translate business needs into clear, structured requirements, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and supporting documentation.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels and follow through to obtain the information needed to resolve ambiguity.

  • Experience working with Jira and Agile software delivery teams.

  • Experience working across multiple teams where shared dependencies, changes or overlapping requirements need to be understood clearly.

  • A good level of technical understanding, enabling effective conversations with engineers about scope, constraints, dependencies and trade-offs.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with good attention to detail and the ability to maintain clarity as requirements evolve.

Desirable experience

  • Experience working in a SaaS or platform engineering environment.

  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations and how platform capabilities can underpin product features.

  • Experience using analysis techniques such as process mapping or user journey mapping.

  • Exposure to software release processes and change management.

Additional Information

All candidates must be able to demonstrate a pre-existing right to work and travel within the UK. We are unfortunately not able to offer sponsorship. Documentary evidence will be required.

All offers are subject to satisfactory vetting and reference checks.

Our Benefits:

  • 🏖 26 days holiday + Bank holidays + buy up to 5 days

  • 🏥 Private Medical insurance with BUPA

  • 🏡 Remote/Hybrid first policy

  • 💙 Employee Assistance programme with WeCare

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Enhanced Family Friendly Benefits

  • 🏋️‍♂️ Gym Discounts

  • 🚀and more!

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are our priorities, and we’re ensuring we have lots of support so our people can grow at SFG20 and do their best work!

We embrace diversity by fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, safe and able to bring their whole self to work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our next Senior Software Engineer in Trust & Safety, you'll own the systems that decide how tradespeople are checked, how reviews are processed and how our marketplace stays honest at scale. You'll work alongside the vetting and reviews teams, who are on the front line of trust, and build the infrastructure that lets them work with confidence. When something breaks in production, you'll lead the response. When something looks brittle at design time, you'll say so.

The job, unfiltered:

  • Own and evolve the systems behind how tradespeople are verified, how reviews flow through our platform and how content is moderated.

  • Lead the response when things break: read distributed traces, correlate logs across services and find the cause, not just the symptom.

  • Design event-driven workflows that are reliable by default: idempotent, retryable, with dead-letter handling that doesn't need a 2am wake-up to unpick.

  • Work directly with the vetting and reviews teams to understand what trust means day to day, then build systems that hold up to it.

  • Tighten the operational seams: better monitoring, clearer alerting, locked-down auth and outbox patterns that keep data consistent.

The fit:

  • Strong TypeScript. You're comfortable owning a service end to end, from schema to deployment.

  • Fastify or a similar Node.js framework, and enough HTTP know-how that it rarely surprises you.

  • Event-driven instincts: you know what idempotency means in practice and why the outbox pattern exists.

  • Full-stack comfort, Next.js included. You ship the frontend as happily as the service behind it.

  • Datadog fluency (APM traces, log search, metric queries), SQL for diagnostics during an incident, and GCP basics such as Pub/Sub backlogs and DLQs.

  • Experience leading production incidents, not just being in them. You communicate clearly under pressure and drive to a fix.

  • An eye for systemic problems at review time, not at post-mortem time, and a habit of making the people around you better.

  • Regular use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, and a keen interest in helping the team get more out of them.

You don't need to know our Trust & Safety domain yet (the review lifecycle, vetting disposition logic, publish timing). You'll pick it up. What matters is that you learn fast and take it seriously.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

  • Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

  • Technical interview with members of the team

  • Final stage with the hiring manager and a senior stakeholder

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for a highly organised & proactive Executive Assistant for our Executives. You will be the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, ensuring efficiency and seamless operations. Your focus will be on managing key personal & professional priorities, and providing administrative and strategic support—allowing our execs to focus on scaling the business through the next phase of growth!

You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time as we’re scaling fast and building the category-defining agentic operating system for procurement. And we are looking for the best Executive Assistant out there to help us turn procurement into a true competitive advantage!

What Can You Expect?

As the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, you’ll proactively coordinate, manage and keep track of your assigned Exec's schedules, projects and commitments. You will work closely with the Omnea leadership team and act as the primary point of contact for key stakeholders on all matters related to our execs. You are someone who acts like an owner, can craft at speed and loves working in a fast-paced environment with significant impact.

You’ll provide strategic and executive support, by managing our executives' complex calendars, ensuring seamless scheduling across multiple time zones. You’ll own email and communication filtering as well as prioritising, drafting, and responding as necessary.

You’ll act as a gatekeeper, ensuring our executives’ time is spent on high-impact activities. You will manage conflicting priorities and prioritise different demands, you’ll focus on solutions, and are comfortable navigating change and removing blockers.

You’ll plan, schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings and ensure agendas are well prepped, action items tracked, minutes taken and follow-ups done in a timely manner. You’ll also assist with board materials, investor updates, and briefing notes.

You’ll organise and book all travel, including flights, hotels, transfers and visas. You’ll prepare detailed travel itineraries and handle last-minute changes seamlessly.

You’ll own all operational and administrative tasks, such as expenses, invoices, and budget tracking related to our executives' activities.

You’ll act as the first point of contact for all key stakeholders, including prospects and customers on behalf of our executives. You’ll manage confidential information with the highest level of discretion. You’ll also proactively solve problems and anticipate potential issues before they arise.

You’ll own systems & processes that improve productivity, such as identifying and implementing tools or processes that reduce admin workload and help outsource and delegate non-essential tasks effectively.

For example, you may be a career changer who did well in a different sector or role but similarly intense & difficult.

  • You are London-based, with 3 days in the office per week and flexibility for occasional travels with the CEO in the future.

  • You are highly organised, with meticulous attention to detail, and exceptional at multitasking. You have flexibility to provide support during off-hours in an environment with increasingly different timezones (Europe & US).

  • You are tech-savvy, with experience using modern productivity tools (e.g., Slack, Notion, Google Suite). You can provide structure within the entrepreneurial and dynamic environment of a company in hyper-scale.

  • You’re able to ruthlessly prioritise, are highly organised and focused on outputs > inputs. You are proactive, a strategic thinker, efficient & autonomous and don’t compromise on quality (i.e. you have taste).

  • You’re an outstanding communicator; verbal, written, and when presenting. You’re exceptionally articulate, concise and clear in all forms of communication and have the ability to build rapport, influence people & drive change, whether it’s with a distinguished exec, technical expert or a junior operator. You handle confidential matters with discretion and professionalism.
